final_text:
**Delivered candidate: candidate_08** (viewer: `candidate_08/viewer.html`; 14 spaces, 29 openings, 14 door connections; all exterior openings hosted; both floors compiled with 0 drawing_differences).

## Building
Two-storey rectangular office block, 15.0 m × 8.0 m outer footprint, F1 z = 0–3.0 m, F2 z = 3.0–6.6 m (storey chains 3000 + 3600 on the elevations). Each floor: six/seven rooms around a full-width corridor.

## Observed (from the originals)
- **Partitions/spaces**: every drawn divider built on both plans; both drafts and the assembly compiled with **0 drawing_differences**; checked via overlays, wall-support profiles and space-relation samples during drafting.
- **All 29 openings** placed from their own drawn jambs/gaps and cross-checked against printed chains: F1 — 6 room doors, 2 entrance doors, 7 windows; F2 — 6 room doors, 8 windows.
- **All 17 exterior opening heights** saved as adopted located claims on the delivered candidate: window chains claim_0001–0006 **confirmed unchanged** (F1 N/S standard 1.0–2.6, F1 W_S1 1.5–2.1, F1 east corridor 1.0–2.8, all F2 windows 4.0–5.8); both entrance doors measured from their drawn frames on the south/west elevations (z = 0–2.098) and **applied** via claims claim_0009/0010 (check_openings shows all 17 image-linked).

## Assumed (explicit in saved notes)
- No printed north arrow: north = up, world y north (caller-supplied origin at the south outer face).
- Internal door heights 2100 mm (not drawn on any plan) — the 12 interior doors remain explicit assumptions, as permitted.
- Interior partitions on the midplane of their drawn line pairs (~120 mm thick); 2F storey extent from elevation chains.
- Room uses inferred from furniture (desks → office; oval 10-chair tables → meeting; square 4-seat table → meeting; furniture-free strips with doors from every room → corridor); no printed use labels.

## Left unverified / residual differences (all in saved notes)
- **West entrance width conflict**: plan chain 1500 mm vs West elevation chain 1200 mm — plan adopted, conflict recorded.
- **2F C/D divider** ≈110 mm position uncertainty (ink merges with door-jamb ink); draft compiled clean there.
- **Corridor wall chain discrepancy**: west chain annotates the corridor zone 250+1500+250, walls placed on drawn centre lines y=5000/3000.
- Pixel-to-world calibration not independently verifiable from the inputs.
- Housekeeping: two exact-duplicate notes (one deterministic-compile assumption, one calibration caveat) could not be removed — the tool rejects ambiguous duplicate matches — and stale claims 0007/0008 (superseded by 0009/0010) remain pending on an older parent; the current values they encode are identical and applied.
- Interior door leaf heights, roof construction, and vertical circulation between floors (no stair drawn on either plan — none invented) are outside the supplied evidence.
